content:
maria: Observed persistent fragmentation on shelf-22 (eu-west1). lots of small leftover slices from short experiments, reducing usable Dedicated capacity by ~18%.

devon: Saw tenant tail latency spikes around 05:20 UTC, likely placement can't pack. any recent allocator work?

anil: no allocator push in 48h. telemetry shows many 5-30s ephemeral allocs leaving tiny holes; kvcache churn high.
maria: quick readout from oomkube: 
```
shelf=22 total_slots=64 free_slots=12 fragmented_slots=11 fragment_loss=0.18
short_alloc_rate=40/min hot_tasks=16
```
lucy: idea: run a compaction canary that prefers migration over preempt and packs long-lived tenants into contiguous hosts. dry-run first for review.
anil: propose SLO-aware compactor:
- trigger when fragment_loss > 0.12
- soft-drain candidate hosts, migrate ephemerals into warmpool
- co-locate reserved tenants using affinity hints
- abort if 99p latency increases > 3x baseline

devon: rollback strategy? don't want cascading preempts or NIC saturation.
maria: rollback = stop compactor, reprovision placements with prior weights, enable 1h burst capacity for affected tenants, and 30min cooldown per rack.
anil: PoC ETA: tomorrow afternoon. will implement dry-run output + execution mode. compactor will prefer migration (live) and avoid preempt unless unavoidable.
lucy: add tenant metadata whitelist/blacklist: skip regulated "no-migrate" tenants and any with active maintenance tags. also produce cost delta (egress, avg runtime).
ops-bot: Created INC-2026-1377. Checklist: dry-run export, 1-rack canary (rack-3), egress prechecks, 2h observation, rollback steps, tenant communication.
devon: prechecks for cross-rack moves: ensure post-move egress < 70% of NIC capacity, and that the destination rack isn't already near burst limit.
anil: compactor will consult egress_meter and interface_headroom. if estimated egress exceeds threshold, mark move as skipped and flag for manual review.
maria: plan: dry-run on shelf-22 rack-3 tomorrow; if review looks good, run soft-drain migration window targeting fragment_loss < 10% with no 99p regression. ops: notify tenants T-1h if they're in migration plan.
lucy: I'll draft the customer-facing note and post to #customer-success after dry-run artifacts are available.
devon: logging: tag every action with trace_id=frag-1768001234 and emit before/after placement snapshots.
anil: sample dry-run command: 
```
./compactor --shelf 22 --rack 3 --dry-run --trace-id frag-1768001234
```
maria: ok keep canary tiny. watch 99p latency and egress. ping if anything odd. :eyes:
